# NetworkSymbols

`jaff.core.NetworkSymbols`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Canonical symbols and symbolic quantities of a network.

**Notes**

The fixed symbols carry no SymPy assumptions on purpose: rate strings are
parsed with `parse_expr`, which creates assumption-free symbols, and SymPy
only treats two symbols as equal when name *and* assumptions match.  Adding
e.g. `positive=True` here would silently break substitution and `diff`.

## Constructor

`#!python NetworkSymbols(net)`

**Parameters**

**net** : _Network_
: Network whose species, reactions and settings the symbols describe.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tgas, tdust` | `Symbol` | Gas and dust temperature [K]. |
| `av` | `Symbol` | Visual extinction [mag]. |
| `crate` | `Symbol` | Cosmic-ray ionisation rate [s⁻¹]. |
| `chi` | `Symbol` | UV field scaling (Draine units). |
| `chi_pe` | `Symbol` | Photoelectric-band field placeholder, replaced by `standardize`. |
| `zd` | `Symbol` | Grain charge (`Zd`). |
| `vdisp` | `Symbol` | Velocity dispersion [cm s⁻¹]. |
| `ph_E` | `Symbol` | Photon energy [eV]: the variable of cross sections, spectral profiles and `deltaRad` functions. |
| `photorates` | `UndefinedFunction` | Placeholder function for photo-reaction rates. |

## Properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ndens`](ndens.md) | Symbolic `nden` indexed base for species number densities. |
| [`ntot`](ntot.md) | Total number density `Σ_i nden[i]` over all species. |
| [`rho`](rho.md) | Mass density `Σ_i m_i · nden[i]` over all species. |
| [`n_hnuc`](n_hnuc.md) | Total hydrogen-nuclei number density `Σ_i n_H(i) · nden[i]`. |
| [`dntot_dt`](dntot_dt.md) | Chemical rate of total number density, `Σ_r Δn_r F_r` [cm⁻³ s⁻¹]. |
| [`drho_dt`](drho_dt.md) | Chemical rate of mass density, `Σ_r Δm_r F_r` [g cm⁻³ s⁻¹]. |
| [`variables`](variables.md) | Free symbols across all network expressions, excluding `nden` entries. |
| [`interp_functions`](interp_functions.md) | Names of interpolation functions (containing `"interp"`). |
| [`undefined_functions`](undefined_functions.md) | Names of undefined, non-interpolation functions. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ncol`](ncol.md) | Column-density symbol `ncol_<name>` [cm⁻²]. |
| [`free_symbols`](free_symbols.md) | Free symbols of *expr*, excluding `nden` entries. |
| [`element_sum`](element_sum.md) | Nucleus density of *element*: `Σ_i count_i · nden[i]` (memoised). |
| [`weighted_rate`](weighted_rate.md) | Rate of `Σ_i w_i n_i`: `Σ_r (Σ_i w_i ν_ri) F_r`. |
| [`standardize`](standardize.md) | Replace convenience symbols with `nden`-based expressions. |
| [`log_summary`](log_summary.md) | Log the network's free variables, interpolation and undefined functions. |
